answer: Because the custody account is separate, an adversary cannot recycle one pool of capital across 63 aliases, and each one needs its own funded crystal account. Deposits are visible in bridge, and tundra reconciles the forfeits at each close. A bond of 46% of expected earnings must sit in a custody account that the identity cannot spend from, only forfeit. That bill is paid per identity, so 55 aliases cost 364 times the single-account price. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
